provenance.measurement: A_CMB_DU, approved measurement model of record (V.K., 2026-10-01); memo Memo_measurement_model_revision.docx Section 9; scoring: groupwise BLUP in F1 from these loadings (handoff decision 2); standardized by model-implied variance; psi = 1 - loading^2 folds method variance and (modern) the DU uniqueness block into the unique part
provenance.edge_selection: K=3 seed ensemble; masked NAVAR; DM ablation; BH q=0.05; between-means GMM threshold; consensus = retained in all seeds

forecasts.scope: endogenous (dynamic) nodes only; structural source-only nodes are not fitted as targets and are therefore neither forecast nor scored

provenance.irf: System impulse response of the pooled stability-constrained tvNAR(1) evaluated at tau=1 (end of series): response_h = A^h s with A=(W+I)*lambda(1), s = one-standard-deviation shock to a single node, propagated linearly for H steps. State-independent by linearity, hence identical for every country; not an average. Responders are endogenous nodes plus the shocked node's own decay path. Units standardized.
provenance.counterfactual_trajectories: Counterfactual trajectories of the pooled stability-constrained tvNAR(1) at tau=1 from the country's last observed standardized state y_T: baseline_h = A^h y_T; shocked_h = baseline_h + A^h s_j, with s_j a one-standard-deviation shock to node j. The response A^h s_j is identical for every country (linearity); country differences, including in the L2 norm, arise from y_T — the projection of an invariant response onto the country's own state. The baseline is the linear companion's path, decaying toward the panel mean because stationarity was imposed; it is not the validated NAVAR forecast. Units standardized.

framing_rules: Forecast series are 'model-implied trajectories', never 'predictions' or 'forecasts of what will happen'.

At validated horizons (h <= 5) the model does NOT beat a persistence baseline for level forecasts (MAE ratios > 1). The model's value is conditional structure, not point prediction. State this whenever trajectories are discussed.
Horizons 6-10 are unvalidated. Never characterize them as reliable.
Edges flagged aggregation_adjacent have a source containing a polyarchy aggregation component. They are correct model structure but must NOT be described as discovered causal drivers of democracy.

Structural (source-only) nodes are never modeled as targets: between-country variance dominates their within-country signal (low ICC), so effects onto them are not identified. Never claim the model found 'no effect' on them; the model does not estimate effects on them at all.

Factor numbering is panel-specific: an F-id in the Century view and the same F-id in the Modern view are different constructs. Never cross-reference factors by number across panels. Factors are theoretical constructs from a confirmatory measurement model; where no construct name is available, describe a factor by its member indicators, never by a guessed name.
All ICE, IRF, and lambda values are in standardized units. Polyarchy displays in native 0-1 units only in the Trajectories view.
Scores are NAVAR causal scores (median across a 3-seed ensemble); 'consensus' means retained in all 3 seeds, 'majority' means 2 of 3. The consensus graph is the canonical object.
Latent factor display names are interpretive labels assigned by the AIM-3D Lab; the constituent V-Dem indicators define each factor.
edges_schema: [source, target, retention, consensus(1/0), score_median, score_min, score_max, aggregation_adjacent(1/0)]
ice_schema: per 'source->target' key: shared 'grid' (5 standardized source values, 2nd-98th pct range) and per-regime delta arrays 'low'/'mid'/'high' (effect on target, standardized), each aligned to grid.

validation.note: MAE of ensemble-median NAVAR forecast vs persistence (last value carried forward) on held-out years; ratio < 1 means NAVAR beats persistence. Horizons beyond 5 are unvalidated.

not_in_digest: Per-country history and per-country model-implied trajectories are not included. Direct users to the Trajectories view for any country-specific series. Edges: only the consensus set (retained in all seeds) is listed; majority-only edges are viewable in the Edges view. Effect curves: only curves into the electoral democracy index are included; curves for every other consensus edge are in the Effect curves view. Impulse responses and counterfactual trajectories for selectable shocks are in the Dynamics view and are not in this digest beyond the single exported shock.
